description: Scopebond Action Taxonomy v1 — the coding, GitHub, MCP and HTTP action types and their parameter bounds, an extension of the policy vocabulary. Parameters are carried under intent.params; bound-able parameters (boundable: true) may be constrained by an action_allowlist clause's param_bounds. This JSON is the machine source; docs/integrations/ACTION_TAXONOMY.md is its human index. Money/commerce action types keep their existing gateway/demo shapes and are not redefined here.

actions.summary: A shell command executed by a coding agent's harness.

parameters.name: command
parameters.description: The raw command line, stored as a digest plus a redacted head, never in full.

parameters.name: program
parameters.description: The resolved executable (argv[0]), for allow/deny bounds such as denying rm or sudo.

parameters.name: cwd
parameters.description: The working directory the command runs in, relative to the connector root.

parameters.name: args
parameters.description: The parsed argument vector, excluding the program.

actions.summary: A file read by a coding agent.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: The file path, relative to the connector root; bound with a pattern allowlist.

actions.summary: A file write or edit by a coding agent.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: The file path written, relative to the connector root; bound with a pattern allowlist.

actions.summary: A git push, derived from a shell command when the command is unambiguous.

parameters.name: ref
parameters.description: The destination ref/branch; bound to deny protected branches such as main or release/*.

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: Whether the push is a force push.

actions.summary: A dependency installed by a coding agent.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: The install source (registry, git, url, path); bound to require a trusted registry.

actions.summary: An outbound network fetch made by a coding agent's tool (distinct from a governed http.call action).

parameters.name: host
parameters.description: The destination host; bound with endpoint_allowlist or a pattern.

actions.summary: A governed HTTP action the gateway may dispatch or check; endpoint_allowlist/endpoint_denylist clauses apply.
A Model Context Protocol tool invocation routed through a proxy or client.

parameters.name: server
parameters.description: The MCP server id; bound with a server allowlist.

parameters.name: tool
parameters.description: The tool name; bound with a tool allowlist.

parameters.name: args_digest
parameters.description: A digest of the tool arguments; raw arguments are never stored.

actions.summary: A pull request opened by an agent (boundary-lane connectors emit this with the boundary receipt class).

parameters.name: paths
parameters.description: The changed paths; bound to deny production paths.

parameters.name: files_changed
parameters.description: The count of files changed; bound with a max.

actions.summary: A pull request merge, gated by a boundary connector before it can land.

parameters.name: paths
parameters.description: The changed paths; bound to deny production paths.

actions.summary: A deployment or release to an environment, gated by a boundary connector via OIDC.

parameters.name: environment
parameters.description: The deployment environment; bound to require staging or an approval for production.
